method.shot_detection: ffmpeg select=gt(scene\,0.24) at 480px, twin detections merged at 0.4 s
method.frames: one still per shot at 45% of the shot, 1280 px wide
method.transitions: cut score + per-shot luma start/end vs mean (fade-to-black detection)
method.voiceover: YouTube Hindi auto-captions (522 deduped cues) — cue windows, not speaker diarisation
method.audio_events: mono 16 kHz: RMS, spectral flatness, autocorrelation pitch strength; music/sfx are heuristics
method.text: tesseract OCR on every still + manual read of the contact sheets
limitations: Slow dissolves/fades are gradual, so a boundary that ffmpeg scores below 0.24 is missing from the shot list.
Music/SFX labels are heuristic: a continuous score under narration reads as music; isolated sound design is indistinguishable from speech onsets in a loudness-normalised mix.
Only 1 onset survived outside the narration windows, so per-shot SFX should be read as 'none detected', not 'none exists'.
Text timings are 'whole shot' — the exact in/out of a text card was not measured frame by frame.
OCR of Hindi cards is unreliable; Hindi strings above were read by eye from the stills.
Shots containing burned-in source UI (playlist overlay, 'SP', timestamps) are marked source_ui.

summary.pacing_note: Median shot is 6.2s, which sits inside a 5-8 s design window, but the distribution is bimodal rather than uniform: 51 shots run 10 s or longer (21 over 20 s, max 50 s) while 40 shots are shorter than 3 s. The short ones cluster around newspaper headlines; the long ones sit on a single news card or a still photo. Narration is near continuous, so the picture is allowed to rest while the voice carries the story.
style_notes: Cold open: 31 s night aerial of fireworks before any context lands.
Still-heavy: news-article cards (The Hindu, TOI, moneycontrol, Al Jazeera, Aaj Tak) held 10-40 s, often with a slow push.
Archive TV and phone footage used raw, with burned-in watermarks, timestamps and playback UI left in.
Dates arrive as on-screen text, not as narration: 'DECEMBER, 2016', '12 NOVEMBER', 'AFTER 17 DAYS'.
Graphics carry the facts: 25 km route map, '4-INCH' pipe callout, supply icons, agency crests.
Emotional peak at 1090 s (rescue, 'AFTER 17 DAYS'), then back to context: Atal Tunnel, Char Dham, Supreme Court.
Ends on an 18 s channel card (logo, subscribe dots).

comparison_to_our_schema.our_scene_length: 5-8 s per scene, 16:9, 1920x1080@30, one image + optional lower third
comparison_to_our_schema.their_scene_length: median 6.2 s, mean 10.5 s, range 0.4-50.3 s
comparison_to_our_schema.gap: Our schema's 5-8 s is right for the median, but it has no way to express what this video does with the other 40% of its shots: hold one still or one news card for 10-50 s while narration explains it. Nor does it cover the 0.4-1 s headline bursts.
feed_for_schema: Add a `still_card` (or `hold`) animation_type for article/headline cards; they are ~30% of this video.
Allow a scene to carry multi-line card text, not just one lower-third line.
Keep Ken Burns as the default treatment: most shots here are slow pushes on stills, archive stills and phone frames.
Add `source_credit` per scene: archive TV, phone footage, news screenshot, agency graphic.
Add an optional `card_image` field so the news card itself is the visual (they are literal screenshots with logos).
Bimodal pacing needs a per-scene override, not one global scene length: 5-8 s for montage, 15-40 s for explainer cards.
